title: 第21章 千万落子，九州启航！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    百分之二十五。

    办公区里键盘敲击的声音似乎都停了一拍。张志东推了一下厚底眼镜，目光从林川脸上移开，看向马化腾。

    马化腾没有立刻说话。

    他的手指无意识地在那张满是咖啡渍的折叠桌上轻轻敲了两下。这个动作很细微，但林川捕捉到了——前世见过太多人在做重大决策前的微表情，这种无意识的手指敲击，说明脑子正在高速运转。

    他正在算账。

    二十来个人的办公区闷热得像个蒸笼，角落里那台落地风扇吱呀吱呀地转，扇叶的节奏像个倒计时。

    陈维明在旁边端起茶杯喝了一口，没插话。他是聪明人，知道这一刻该让主角们自己谈。

    沉默持续了大概十秒钟。

    “林总。”马化腾开口了，声音不大，但每个字咬得很清楚，“我问两件事。”

    林川微微抬了下下巴。

    “第一，一千万，什么时候到？”

    “签完协议，三天之内全额到账。不分批，不拖。”林川的回答干脆得像刀切豆腐。

    马化腾点了一下头，表情没有太大变化。但坐在他旁边的张志东呼吸明显重了一拍——三天到一千万，对于一个连下个月服务器租金都在发愁的公司来说，这句话的分量比任何商业计划书都重。

    “第二。”马化腾盯着林川的眼睛，镜片后面的目光变得锐利起来，“百分之二十五，加一个董事席位。林总拿了这些之后——”

    他顿了一下。

    “打算怎么管我们？”

    这个问题一出来，张志东也把身体微微前倾了几度。

    创始人和财务投资者之间最核心的那根刺，被马化腾直接摆在了桌面上。

    林川心里暗暗点了个头。这个人能在日后把腾讯从一间破办公室做到万亿帝国，不是没道理的。就算穷到服务器告警、发不出工资，该守的底线他一寸都不让。

    “马总。”林川身体往后一靠，双手交叠在膝盖上，语气松弛下来。

    “我投你这一千万，不是来当你老板的。”

    “日常怎么运营，产品怎么做，技术怎么迭代——我不懂，也不打算假装懂。这些事，你和你的团队说了算。”

    他竖起一根手指。

    “董事席位，我要的是知情权。公司在往哪个方向走，关键节点上发生了什么，融资、扩张、战略调整——这些事我需要知道，也有权参与讨论。但最终拍板的人，是你。”

    安静。

    风扇还在转。远处机房里服务器嗡嗡的低鸣声像一个不知疲倦的心跳。

    “我再说直白一点。”林川的目光扫过马化腾和张志东，嘴角勾起一抹很浅的弧度。

    “你们这间屋子里坐着的这帮人，写的每一行代码，扛的每一台服务器，比我的一千万值钱多了。我只是买了一张门票，上场打球的人还是你们。”

    张志东的嘴角动了一下。

    他扭头看了马化腾一眼。

    那个眼神里没有太多复杂的东西，就是一句话——这钱，可以拿。

    马化腾沉默了大概五秒。

    在这五秒里，他的手指停止了敲击。

    “一千万，百分之二十五，一个董事席位。”马化腾轻声重复了一遍，像是在做最后一次确认，“三天内全额到账。日常经营腾讯团队主导，你不干预。”

    “对。”

    马化腾站起来了。

    他伸出手。

    那只手掌心有薄茧，指节偏瘦，但伸出来的时候很稳。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Twenty-five percent.

The sound of keyboard typing in the office area seemed to have stopped for a moment.Zhang Zhidong pushed up his thick-soled glasses, looked away from Lin Chuan's face, and looked at Ma Huateng.

Ma Huateng did not speak immediately.

His fingers unconsciously tapped twice on the coffee-stained folding table.This movement was very subtle, but Lin Chuan captured it - he had seen too many micro-expressions of people before making major decisions in his previous life. This unconscious finger tapping showed that the brain was running at high speed.

He is settling accounts.

The office area with about twenty people was as stuffy as a steamer. The floor-standing fan in the corner was spinning, and the rhythm of the fan blades was like a countdown.

Chen Weiming picked up the tea cup and took a sip without interrupting.He is a smart man and knows that at this moment it is time for the protagonists to talk for themselves.

The silence lasted about ten seconds.

"Mr. Lin." Ma Huateng spoke, his voice was not loud, but he spoke each word clearly, "I want to ask two things."

Lin Chuan raised his chin slightly.

"First, ten million, when will it arrive?"

"After signing the agreement, the full amount will be paid within three days. No batches, no delay." Lin Chuan's answer was as simple as cutting tofu with a knife.

Ma Huateng nodded, his expression not changing much.But Zhang Zhidong, who was sitting next to him, was breathing heavily - three days to 10 million. For a company that is worried about next month's server rent, this sentence carries more weight than any business plan.

"Second." Ma Huateng stared at Lin Chuan's eyes, his gaze behind the lenses became sharper, "Twenty-five percent, plus a director seat. After Mr. Lin takes these -"

He paused.

"How are you going to control us?"

As soon as this question came out, Zhang Zhidong also leaned his body slightly forward a few degrees.

The core thorn between founders and financial investors was directly put on the table by Ma Huateng.

Lin Chuan nodded secretly in his heart.It is not unreasonable that this person can turn Tencent from a shabby office into a trillion-dollar empire in the future.Even if he was so poor that the server alerted him and he couldn't pay wages, he would not give up an inch of the bottom line that he should adhere to.

"Mr. Ma." Lin Chuan leaned back, folded his hands on his knees, and spoke in a relaxed tone.

"I invested ten million in you, not to be your boss."

"How to operate daily, how to make products, how to iterate technology - I don't understand, and I don't intend to pretend to understand. You and your team have the final say on these things."

He raised a finger.

“For the board seat, what I want is the right to know. In which direction the company is heading, what is happening at key nodes, financing, expansion, strategic adjustments – I need to know these things, and I have the right to participate in discussions. But the person who makes the final decision is you.”

Quiet.

The fan is still spinning.The low hum of the servers in the distant computer room was like a tireless heartbeat.

"Let me be more straightforward." Lin Chuan glanced at Ma Huateng and Zhang Zhidong, and the corners of his mouth raised a slight arc.

"Every line of code you write and every server you carry as a group of people sitting in this room are worth much more than my 10 million. I just bought a ticket, and you are still the ones playing on the court."

The corners of Zhang Zhidong’s mouth moved.

He turned his head and glanced at Ma Huateng.

There wasn’t much complexity in that look, just one sentence - you can take this money.

Ma Huateng was silent for about five seconds.

During these five seconds, his fingers stopped tapping.

"Ten million, 25%, and a director seat." Ma Huateng repeated softly, as if making a final confirmation, "The full amount will be paid within three days. The daily operations are led by the Tencent team, and you will not interfere."

"Yes."

Ma Huateng stood up.

He held out his hand.

The palm of that hand has a thin callus and the knuckles are thin, but it is stable when stretched out.
